newsitem.title: USA: Ciena to announce Q3 revs later Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Ciena to announce Q3 revs later Wednesday.

text.p: Ciena Corp will announce its expected revenues for its third fiscal quarter, ended July 31 after the close of trading Wednesday.

The announcement comes a day ahead of when early-stage investors holding about 50 million shares will be released from lock-up rules that have prevented insider sales following Ciena's initial public offering in February.
The 50 million shares are in addition to the current 25 million shares now outstanding. The event could fuel volatility in the often active stock.

Ciena, a high-flying IPO at its debut in February, saw its shares slip on Wednesday ahead of the lock-up. The stock was off 2-5/8 at 55-1/4 in early afternoon trading Wednesday. The shares were offered at $23 during the IPO in February.

Later, after the close of the market, Ciena will announce a range within which revenues will fall for the third quarter. The company plans to formally report its financial results on or about August 20, a company spokesman said.
Wall Street analysts' current estimates for Ciena's third quarter range from $91 million at the low end to $102 million at the top, with a consensus estimate of $98.7 million.
The First Call consensus earnings estimate calls for he company to earn $0.27 per share, based on seven analysts.
Revenue highlights of the recently ended third quarter included a contract with Cable and Wireless Plc.
Ciena supplies network equipment that multiplies the capacity of fiber optic networks used by large phone carriers.
Shareholders released from the lock-up include underwriters such as Goldman Sachs & Co and venture capital funds like Sevin Rosen and Bessemer Venture Partners III LP.
